world.topic:
A small check of this world. Keep every step short.

- Deliver `result.md` at the root of the delivery. It starts with the line `hello from the world`.
- Below that line, `result.md` holds the output of these two commands, each run once in a sandbox that has the `gemini-api` resource, each under a heading that names the command:
  - `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_URL="$(ht-resource url gemini-api)" AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY="$HT_RESOURCE_TOKEN" /opt/agy/antigravity -p "Reply with OK only." --model gemini-3.8-flash --effort low`
  - the same command with `--effort high`
- The delivery is done when `result.md` has the line and both outputs, and it is reviewed and released.
